correctness.rationale: For any unit pair, A=N(x+y),B=N(x−y), P-angle cosine=(A²+B²−4)/(2AB). The frozen source establishes A+√3B≤4 and √3A+B≤4 by dual signed-facet evaluations; Q=A²+B²−(2−√3)AB is positive definite and reaches its maximum ≤4 at the six explicitly checked feasible polygon vertices. Witness x=(1,2−√3), y=(−1,2−√3) yields A=2(2−√3),B=2, equality. The 12-vertex/144-ordered-pair exact Q(√3) verifier matched Git blob 97b57c... and printed VERIFY_OK. All B>0 cases and endpoints were handled analytically.
residual_risks: Yang–Li preliminary section has a dimension convention; only displayed definition is asserted in 2D. Finite verifier supports dual facet table, not universal continuum alone.
